text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day, during the lead-up to Mejiro
Ardan's
debut race, we're both making
our way toward
the training track when...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Oh my, isn't that...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Pant... Pant! Yaeno... you never fail to impress! Your running's looking even sharper than before!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Heh... Chiyono O, your running is a
testament to
the enormity of your
efforts. You have inspired
me to
redouble my own resolve.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I follow Mejiro Ardan's gaze to see two

Umamusume engaging in friendly
competition.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One of them is Sakura Chiyono O, a
cheerful
student known for her sincere,
hardworking
personality.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The other is Yaeno Muteki, a runner with
the
composure of a seasoned martial
artist.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And both racers are in the same year as
Mejiro
Ardan!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
They're both so diligent in their training.
I would
do well to follow their example.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Yes. They are very dear friends of mine.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Especially Chiyono O. We're roommates,
after all.
She often helps me prepare for
my trips to and
from the hospital, and
sometimes even visits me
there to keep
me company.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
You're finally out of the hospital and can
come to
school again! Congratulations,
Ardan!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Hehe, thank you.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Ardan's words stir a memory of
Sakura
Chiyono O greeting her at the
academy gates
following her discharge
from hospital...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Truly... I am indebted to her.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Ah! Ardaaan!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Are you about to start training right now
too?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
I am. My debut race is fast approaching,
so I wish
to fit in some last-minute
practice.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I can't believe it's finally happening! I'm
so
excited to race alongside you in the
Twinkle
Series, Ardan!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: I feel the same as Chiyono O.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Yaeno...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
It will be my pleasure to compete
against you as
your peer. But before
that, I hope you'll allow me
to cheer you
on during your debut race.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
...It's an honor to hear such things from
you both.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: However...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
I intend to give my all in my upcoming
debut
race, even at the risk of my own
life.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Given my physical condition, I'm sorry to
say that
I can make no promises as to
whether I'll be able
to run with you both.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Now, if you'll excuse me, I'm going to
begin
training. I hope to see you both
soon...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Trainer, shall we begin?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Although I'm surprised at what Mejiro
Ardan said,
she doesn't give me long to
linger in shock, and I
quickly follow after
her toward the track.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Pant, pant, pant...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Pant... Pant... ...My heart rate is stable, and I'm not experiencing any issues with my legs, so, for the next set...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With her debut race approaching, Mejiro
Ardan's
passion burns with greater
intensity every passing
day. Today,
again, she seems to be testing the

boundaries of her own limits...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Given my physical condition, I'm sorry to
say that
I can make no promises as to
whether I'll be able
to run with you both.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As her trainer, I thought I had at least a
vague
idea of how much she puts on the
line every time
she enters a race.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
But I never imagined she'd express her

determination so firmly, let alone to
such close
friends.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
While wondering how Sakura Chiyono O
and
Yaeno Muteki might have taken
Mejiro Ardan's
words...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Um, Ardan's trainer!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Sorry to trouble you in the middle of
training, but
could I talk to you about
something, please?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: It's about Ardan, um...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: ...Thank you very much!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I guess you would be confused since
I just
came up to you out of the blue.
Well, long story
short...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: There was this one period when Ardan was hospitalized a lot, and sometimes—and I do mean sometimes—there would be this vaguely lonely look on her face...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Whenever I noticed that look, she'd
brush it off
with a giggle... But somehow,
I just couldn't shake
off the feeling that
she was always forcing herself
to smile,
for my sake.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Recently, though, I've seen so many
great big
smiles on her face! Way more
than before! And
the determination she
showed back there on the
training track
was incredible too.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Seeing that side of Ardan, I just couldn't
contain
my happiness! And I thought to
myself, I really
need to put in more
effort myself!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
...The cause of that change is you,
Trainer. She's
like this because you've
been there for her ever
since the tryout.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I couldn't cheer her up on my own. So,
that's why I
wanted to thank you...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: W-well, if anything, she's the one who's been looking out for me! She's such a wonderful roommate and—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
...I know Ardan has her doubts, but I
believe in
her.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I have faith that she'll ace her debut and
be able
to race together with Yaeno and
me!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I have an inkling myself of just how
profound her
feelings about racing are.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
But it's not like I'm any less committed
myself!
That's why, when we eventually
compete
someday, I'm going to race
with all I've got!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Especially for the Japanese Derby...
There's no
way I'm letting anybody else
win that!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
...I'm sorry for going on such a long rant!
I-I think
I'd better get going now! Thank
you for lending
me your ear!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Even Mejiro Ardan's dear friends have
absolute
faith in her ability to make it to
the Twinkle
Series...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Which means, as her trainer, I've got to
work even
harder to make sure she
meets their expectations!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Meanwhile, at the training gym...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: ...Phew! One last rep!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Clang!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Perfect. Next is...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Given my physical condition, I'm sorry to
say that
I can make no promises as to
whether I'll be able
to run with you both.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
That's what you said today. Still, I am
positive...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Someday you will reappear before me,
as a
mighty opponent to be overcome!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I have been sure of this since I saw you
run at the
tryout that day.

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
By the narrowest possible margin, it's
Mejiro
Ardan! She's crossed the finish
line!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Ladies and gentlemen, your winner for
the
tryout—give it up for Mejirooo
Ardaaan!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I trembled at the sight of it. That
1,200-meter
stretch of dirt was by no
means your
element—neither the
distance nor the surface
worked in your
favor—but you overcame it all and

emerged triumphant.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Seeing the way you ran, I sensed in you
something
that I lacked... That
obsession—that steeled
resolve!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
...Ardan. The raging fire that fuels your
legs will
surely not sputter out after a
lone debut race.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
If I am to be at my best when our clash
comes...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Then I must train!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The three racers' hopes connect in this
quiet
moment—the still before the storm
of Mejiro
Ardan's debut race!
